name: Aaron Reveles
office: Montebello Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 2

items.text: Aaron Reveles is a high school teacher running for Montebello Unified School District board, Trustee Area 2. His campaign cites eight years of teaching experience and a background in community and labor organizing. His campaign prioritizes fully funding schools and supporting students and families. He supports reducing class sizes, expanding early childhood education and Pre-K, strengthening special education, and ensuring educators have needed resources. He advocates for meaningful parent and community engagement and culturally responsive education. In a 2022 voter guide, he supported charter school accountability, LGBTQ+ equity, environmental justice, and removing police from campuses. Another 2022 guide noted his support for a Green New Deal for public schools and giving employees and the community more say over discretionary spending.
